mathematical_result.name: QFORM-TRANSLATION-UNIFORM-CONTAMINATED-NULL-CLEAN-SQUARE-v1
mathematical_result.statement: If independent innovations S0,Z are independent of arbitrary nuisance (W,Theta), W has a bounded marginal density, and Q=c+2aW(sigma S0+r)+b(Z+t)^2 with arbitrary nuisance-dependent translations, then Q has continuous bounded density with norm at most 6(K L F/|sigma|)^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3).
mathematical_result.parseval_corollary: For 2UW+V^2 with heavy row c>=1/2 and clean square mass tau on residual coordinates unused by alpha and gamma, norm <=6 e^(2/3)c^(-1/3)tau^(-2/3), continuously.
mathematical_result.explicit_example: U=X0/sqrt(2)+(X1+X2)/2, W=(X1-X2)/sqrt(2), V=X3 has physical spectrum {-1,0,1,1}; bound <=6(2e)^(1/3)<10.551.
